svg.title: SimLM tier 3 with document chunking plus Q&A pairs
svg.desc: Offline, an LLM reads source documents and produces two outputs: curated Q&A pairs and semantic chunks. Both are embedded by a sentence model into pgvector. At runtime, the query is embedded and matched by nearest neighbor across both pairs and chunks, then a threshold decides between the stored answer and a fallback.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I split source docs into sections first?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM produce both pairs and chunks from a doc?')
sendPrompt('What are the Q&A pairs used for vs chunks?')
sendPrompt('Why store raw chunks alongside pairs as a fallback?')
sendPrompt('Which sentence embedding model fits vi + en?')
sendPrompt('How do I store pair and chunk vectors in pgvector?')
sendPrompt('How is the query normalized before embedding?')
sendPrompt('Why same embedding model on query and store?')
sendPrompt('How does nearest neighbor search across pairs and chunks?')
sendPrompt('How do I tune the similarity threshold across two vector types?')
sendPrompt('How is the stored answer or chunk returned?')
sendPrompt('What does T3 return when nothing passes threshold?')
